name: hamming_window_periodic_alpha
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::hamming_window.periodic_alpha(int window_length, bool periodic, float alpha, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=None) -> Tensor. Constructs a strided floating-point Hamming window using the explicit periodic flag and alpha coefficient; the beta coefficient remains the overload-defined 0.46. Tests cover zero and singleton lengths, periodic and symmetric windows, legacy lengths and coefficients, coefficient boundaries, default dtype, pin_memory=False, Python requires_grad dispatch, and invalid length, dtype, and layout.
